result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The only visual defects are the partially visible category chip at the right edge of the horizontally scrollable filter row and the second 'Popular right now' card being cut off by the bottom viewport edge, both of which are expected behaviors for scrollable content and not defects. No other broken layout, clipping, contrast, or missing-element problems were observed.
